SELECT sb.student_id as studentId, cce.coach_id as coachId, cce.course_id as courseId, sb.user_course_package_id as userCoursePackageId, cce.id as sessionEventId, cce.title, cce.start_ts as startTs, cce.end_ts as endTs, cce.capacity, cce.booked_count as bookedCount, sb.status as bookingStatus, sb.booked_at as bookedAt, sb.cancelled_at as cancelledAt FROM public.session_booking sb JOIN public.coach_calendar_event cce ON cce.id = sb.event_id WHERE cce.kind = 'session' AND sb.student_id = #{studentId}::uuid
AND cce.start_ts >= #{fromDate}::timestamp
AND cce.start_ts < #{toDate}::timestamp
ORDER BY cce.start_ts ASC
